newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Thai groups in US$260 mln property deal.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Thai groups in US$260 mln property deal.

text.p: Singapore's South East Asia Property Company (SEAPC) and Thailand's President Park Properties PCL have formed a property joint venture, President Park said in a statement on Thursday.

The new company, President-Park-SPI Co Ltd, will invest in, own, develop and manage service apartments in Thailand and Asia, the statement said. It said SEAPC will hold a 49 percent stake and President Park the remainder in the company to be incorporated in Thailand.

President Park will transfer to the joint venture firm its current asset base of US$85 million made up of luxury service apartments in central Bangkok and 10,300 sq metres of land at Sukhumvit Soi 24, also in Bangkok, to be developed into a housing complex, including service apartments.
This asset base is expected to reach US$260 million on completion of the Sukhumvit Soi 24 project in 1999, it said.

SEAPC's shareholders are Singapore's government-linked Temasek Holdings (Private) Ltd, The Prudential Insurance Co of America, The Australia Mutual Provident Society, ING Group, The Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and The New South Wales Superannuation Investment and Management Corporation.
